edits.why: "In sight too long" read out the rule (a time limit). The title says what happened, in the line's words.

Sky, on "Robots coming / an agent stayed too long beside the café · 2:46": "why is that a bad thing? What was the agent doing?" The short now says who saw, who was seen and what they seemed to do. A watcher's clock counts while an agent stands still, idle or Watching (GameAttention.cs), so "idling" is what any watcher sees; "waiting" was 5 px over at the widest pair, the entrance camera and the Enforcer, and untrue for a Watch.
